The differential law, third arm — --fast ≡ --scan (shipped) · x86-64 ≡ arm64 (shipped) · python ≡ node: same ids, order, locs, headings, band; scores equal after round(9).
Pre-registered before the first line of node/ — 0 discordant rows over every golden × every verb × both corpora × both ISAs. A port that "improves" anything has diverged.
QUERY — EVERY CALL, IN EITHER RUNTIME · what v3 adds to the pipeline, left to right
int8 dot per chunk, int32 acc
three documents share one byte budget
find gains precision, not cleverness: --phrase (adjacency post-filter, local text) · --under <dir> · --all (every term). ask marks tie: true. answer alone may abstain.
Nothing here touches the committed index; every stage is query-time, tune-file, or skill text. The receipt records --expand, -q and the embedder identity, so fux verify can replay.
